_comment: Copy to ab.<site>.json (gitignored) and fill in. Templates are shell lines; {port} {name} {log} {model} {host} are substituted, everything else (including curl's %{http_code}) is left alone.

arms.name: spec-n3
arms.launch: ssh user@SERVER-HOST-OR-IP 'nohup env HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 llama-server -m /path/model-MTP.gguf --device ROCm0 -ngl 99 --port {port} --spec-type draft-mtp --spec-draft-n-max 3 > /tmp/{log}.log 2>&1 & echo $!'

arms.name: spec-n4-pmin0.5
arms.launch: ssh user@SERVER-HOST-OR-IP 'nohup env HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 llama-server -m /path/model-MTP.gguf --device ROCm0 -ngl 99 --port {port} --spec-type draft-mtp --spec-draft-n-max 4 --spec-draft-p-min 0.5 > /tmp/{log}.log 2>&1 & echo $!'

interference.name: second-engine-saturated
interference.start: ssh user@SERVER-HOST-OR-IP 'cd /path/to/perf-bench && nohup python3 hammer.py --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080 --model OTHER-MODEL --concurrency 2 --max-tokens 512 --duration 600 > /tmp/{log}.log 2>&1 & echo $!'
